idea: 短板补齐与长板崩塌策略：基于行业内分位数，识别'最差成分仍在高位'（全部优秀）和'最好成分仍在低位'（全部劣质）的极端情况。当min(E,S,G)处于行业前25%时做多（无短板），当max(E,S,G)处于行业后25%时做空（无长板），中间状态不持仓。该模板利用max/min和trade_when捕捉ESG风险的极端不对称性，实现头尾两极分化交易。
expression_list: trade_when(greater(min(min(group_rank(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_e,63),4), industry), group_rank(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_s,63),4), industry)), group_rank(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_g,63),4), industry)), 0.75), group_zscore(add(add(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_e,63),4), winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_s,63),4)), winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_g,63),4)), industry), trade_when(less(max(max(group_rank(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_e,63),4), industry), group_rank(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_s,63),4), industry)), group_rank(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_g,63),4), industry)), 0.25), reverse(group_zscore(add(add(winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_e,63),4), winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_s,63),4)), winsorize(ts_backfill(rsk74_factor_g,63),4)), industry)), 0))
